name: ML-KEM (Kyber)
type: KEM — key encapsulation (replaces RSA/ECDH key exchange)
purpose: Public-key encapsulation for TLS 1.3, SSH, VPN, hybrid key exchange.
security: ML-KEM-512 ≈ AES-128, ML-KEM-768 ≈ AES-192, ML-KEM-1024 ≈ AES-256
status: Finalized Aug 2024. Deployed in Chrome/Edge TLS (X25519MLKEM768 hybrid) since 2023.
notes: Default choice for ephemeral key exchange. Use with hybrid (X25519+ML-KEM) until ecosystem trusts standalone KEM-only handshakes.
